propositions: True escaped-defect rate and detection-stage efficiency cannot be calculated because only 1.1% (7/648) of current bugs have detected_by provenance metadata, preventing reliable denominators and effectiveness measurement.

Plan-review first-pass rate is 49.0% with p90 attempt count of 8, consuming 114.72 LLM calls per accepted completion-PASS; deterministic structural preflight could reduce churn before semantic review while targeting ≥70% first-pass and p90≤4 attempts.

Completion first-pass is 72.3% overall (72.3%) but reaches 79.7% for tickets with Testing headings and 74.2% for declared file-impact tickets; completion non-PASS reasons are not classified, blocking analysis of defect versus evidence/environment/verifier failures.

Code-review first-pass is 97.4%, but this describes funnel throughput, not reviewer effectiveness; caused_by blame attribution is demonstrably noisy (28/29 first-pass despite low initial plan rate 30.3%), and Gerrit reviewer/vote concentration was not measured.

Debt pressure exists: 35 modules at or above 720 LOC, 15 at 780+, and 4.09% duplication; same-file retouch is 47.7% of consecutive pairs; but no causal link to defects or rework has been established within the 68-day window.

Governance adoption matured Q2→Q3: ticket trailers 0%→90.4%, DCO 0%→82.9%, Change-Id 0%→99.3%, and source diffs became smaller (median 111.5→95 lines) with increased test co-change (84.5→160.5 lines), but this is observational and process-maturation confounded by workload changes.
